split.generation: Two stratified train_test_split operations on sorted participant IDs, stratum=any raw FoG; test_size=4 seed20261029, validation_size=4 seed20261030; one draw, no performance-based retries

svm.score: sigmoid of margin, not calibrated probability

noise_scale: 0.05 or 0.15 times per-channel finite raw TRAIN standard deviation; frozen before validation/test
rotation: 15 degrees about fixed unit (1,1,1) axis, same rigid transform for accel and gyro at both positions
gyro_bias: Add 3 deg/s on z-axis at both positions
dropout: Required six channels missing for [5,6) seconds and every 10s thereafter relative to each raw record start; no label-based timing
training_policy: Fit every model from scratch on TRAIN only; CNN epochs fixed, no early stopping; scaler/CNN normalization/train noise statistics cannot use validation or test
lock_policy: Write model hashes and validation-only thresholds/winner before separate test process; do not refit on train+validation or full22 after testing
joint_policy: Validation-selected primary plus fixed ankle RF, routing by prediction availability only; never select using test results
limitations: New fixed internal split of an already inspected cohort, not untouched external validation
Four test participants, limited and imbalanced FoG events
Stress is artificial sensor perturbation with preserved time/labels, not new real patients or proven physiological synthesis
Dropout changes available windows; evaluate all raw test records/events and unknown support
